sections.title: Bookings
sections.sql: select code,name,event_date,guests,status from events where event_date between current_date and current_date+6 and status<>'cancelled' order by event_date,code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select code,name,issue from attention_queue order by code,issue

sections.title: Kitchen prep
sections.sql: select code,item,portions,allergens from kitchen_prep where event_date between current_date and current_date+6 order by code,item
